scope: Generated low-level JSON operation registry and separate NativeAPI client; high-level E7-02 facade and full E7-03 coverage remain open.

source.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 API documentation, retained as verification-only snapshot
source.distribution_policy: Runtime output is generated from an independently authored structural overlay and contains no OpenAPI descriptions or schemas.

runtime_contract.client: NativeAPI owns its credential and HTTP pool; Bot and SetupClient are not generated or overwritten.
runtime_contract.validation: Exact generated operation, exact path placeholders, percent-encoded segments, structural JSON body, safe query scalars/sequences and exact declared success statuses.
runtime_contract.errors: Existing typed 401/403/429/API errors; redirects refused; uncertain writes are not retried.
runtime_contract.response: Raw decoded JSON; no unsupported schema-model claim.
runtime_contract.unsupported: Arbitrary paths, operations outside the registry, multipart/binary responses, response-header contracts and schema-generated models.

native_stand.credential: ordinary bot token; no setup credential or administrative fallback
native_stand.cleanup: Reaction removed and generated post soft-deleted.
native_stand.explicit_status_override: SaveReaction accepts documented 201 and native-observed 200 only.
provider_openapi_deviations: Empty GetPreferences returned JSON null while pinned OpenAPI declares an array. Raw low-level response is preserved.

tests.per_version: 454 tests + 285 subtests, real Redis, zero skips
tests.quality: Ruff check/format passed; strict mypy passed for 126 source files; extraction replay/audit ready for 21 modules; 15 behavioral suites passed.

distributions.wheel_and_sdist_install: Each installed outside checkout: 74 unit + 75 integration + 1 Redis config + 16 real Redis + 28 provisioning tests.
